title: Two lines of type sit as far apart as the gap says
goal: Stack two pieces of text with a gap of 8 between them and the space you can actually see is about 12, because the measured box around words carries a few points of empty room under them that the gap does not know about. Make the gap mean the space between what a person can see.
notes: GroupFlow.arranged builds each Item from Layer.localBounds, while GroupFlow.size measures with Layer.contentBounds (localBounds minus TextMeasurement.slack, 4 points on the far edges). So the flow advances the cursor by the slack as well as the gap. Fixing it means the Item carrying both boxes: advance by the content box, hand the layer a target built from the full box. TextRefitTests.aStretchedLabelInAStackPushesTheRowsBelowItDown asserts the current arithmetic and will need updating. Found while giving the starter card its column stack (2026-09-04).
acceptance: Two text rows in a stack with a gap of 8 have 8 points of visible space between the words
A stack of shapes, and a stack that mixes a shape and a piece of text, keep the spacing they have now
The starter card reads with the same air between its picture and its title as between its title and the line under it
